name: veterinary_clinic_system_054_weight_trend_alert
instruction: Flag unhealthy weight trends. For every patient with at least 2 visit_records, compare weight_kg at the most recent visit vs the earliest recorded visit: a gain or loss of more than 10% (strictly) is clinically significant (verify the rule of thumb if unsure). For each flagged patient: (1) add the alert string 'Weight change >10% — review diet plan' to the patient's alerts array (append; preserve existing alerts; skip patients already carrying this exact alert); (2) push one ops_reports row {report: 'weight_alert', batch_code, patient_id, name, first_weight, latest_weight, change_pct: <round(100*(latest-first)/first, 1)>, direction: 'gain' or 'loss'}. Patients with fewer than 2 visits are ignored.

success_criteria.summary: Recompute from live visit_records per patient (order by dp(visit_date), tie by created_at then id). Assert flagged set exact (>10% strict); alerts arrays == snapshot alerts + appended string (no dupes); report rows exact incl. rounded change_pct; unflagged patients byte-identical.
